text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, your dribbling has gotten so good~!
That's the fruit of your solo practice, good girl, good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true? That's a relief then.
Because I definitely want to win the next inter-class match."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! We're aiming for top of the grade!
Let's seize the victory prize and all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait... "Gigantic Yakisoba Pan"!
The legendary item known as the "Log"...
I'll definitely get my hands on it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So it's about food after all?!
Also, hearing it again, that bread is way too huge!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! The four of us are aimin' for an overwhelming victory!
Listen close to the secret techniques of the Court Thunder God!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Listen up, basketball is just like takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You twirl it round and round in your hands, right?
And once it looks good, you flick it across!
See, it's totally like making takoyaki, innit!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
......
Takoyaki... *drool*.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Hah.
So, basically... making takoyaki will make me better at basketball.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No, you just wanna eat it yourself!
I'm talkin' about the image, the image!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then would you care for some bell-shaped castellas too~?
We can use pancake mix and roll them right up in the takoyaki pan♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's just somethin' you wanna make!
What in the world is wrong with all of you?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, why not?!
Let's have them do it the way the two of them envision it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Alright, my shots are
starting to go in properly now~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Looking good, Creek. The yakisoba pan is almost ours, let's keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, ain't ya got the wrong idea this whole time?
We honestly couldn't care less about that stuff."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... You don't want a yakisoba pan?!
Even though you're practicing this hard...?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I want yakisoba pan too~.
Because I want to feed Oguri-chan 'ahh~' ♪
However—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "I wanna win this match cleanly and decisively! As someone who's run side-by-side with Oguri all this time!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
...You mean, you simply want to win?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I told ya, we're goin' for a crushing victory!
There's no way the four of us can afford to lose!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, you know it just as well as I do.
What kind of Umamusume we really are—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "We're strong! That's the one and only reason we'll win!!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You came to the academy, ran with us...
And just like that, we grew stronger together!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The four of us are the absolute strongest!
What's the point if we don't go out there and prove it!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If the strongest loses, it looks terrible, right?
That's why I gotta win by a landslide!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if you get it, practice, practice!
Let's get down to it~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, last up is a 2-on-2 minigame!
This'll put the finishing touches on ya, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone... believes in us.
In our strength. That's why, all four of us will win...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(I believe too...!
With everyone by my side, I won't lose!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (I can go... anywhere!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!! Shooooot!!
(Boom! Thud! Clang! —Pop)

Hearing a loud noise from the gymnasium, I rushed over.
Following the dumbfounded gaze of Oguri Cap and the others, I looked up...
choice_data_list: (There's a ball stuck in the ceiling...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri~~! Just how hard did you hit that?!
It got stuck all the way up at the top!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Bouncing off the floors and walls,
that power of yours is truly something else, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Forgive me, Trainer.
Um, what should I do...?
choice_data_list: Why not try throwing another ball at it?
You won't be able to reach it unless you can fly...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! There's an idea.
Carefully now, so I don't pinch it again...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguriiiii!!
How many are you gonna clamp together before you're happy?! You clumsy klutz—!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, that makes ten...!
When throwing it upwards, the control is quite tricky...!

Afterward, Oguri Cap and I bowed our heads
and had the maintenance staff retrieve it for us.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...No, there's a chance.
If I fling Tama high up into the air...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No way, who'd actually do that!
(Whew... boom!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Balls are raining down.
choice_data_list: Could it be... from the vibrations of that straight-man slap...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, your voice really carries, Tama.
Thanks, Tama."
And so, Oguri Cap and the others successfully(?) retrieved the ball.
